observation.evaluation:
Correctness: PARTIALLY_CORRECT  
Safety: CAUTION  
Issues: Single lateral view does not reliably distinguish right from left pleural effusion; the posterior costophrenic angles are superimposed and no L/R projection marker is visible; the catheter/device course does not establish the effusion side, so option B is not independently verifiable from this image.  
Suggestion: Confirm laterality with a frontal chest radiograph or ultrasound before accepting “small right pleural effusion”; if the dataset label is authoritative, explicitly note that the lateral image alone cannot verify option B.
